reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: app.get('/health') exists at index.ts:L38-65 and is a registered HTTP route, publicly reachable without any caller requirement. Gate 2: The entry point is an unauthenticated HTTP request — no trust_assumptions in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE cover this vector. Gate 3: src/index.ts is explicitly in scope. The response unconditionally includes client.ws.status, client.user?.tag, guildId, and raw e.message from Discord API exceptions — an attacker can trigger this via GET /health with no credentials, receiving internal Discord bot state and raw error text. Severity held at Low: disclosure is real but limited to reconnaissance-grade data (bot tag, WebSocket state, guild ID, error strings) with no direct path to privilege escalation.
